Five focused kits. One place to find the tool for the task.

Micro Tools Studio is open with practical digital workspaces for freelancers, small teams and everyday record keeping:

• InvoiceForge — invoice balances and follow-up drafts · $19
• Agency OS — project scope, deposits and onboarding · $39
• CertPai — renewal records and review dates · $15
• SiteIntellect — manual website checks and handoff notes · $19
• ClaimProof — warranty records and evidence references · $9

One-time USD prices, before applicable tax. Each kit is a downloadable ZIP with a browser workspace and companion files. Desktop or laptop recommended. You review the records and take the action; these kits do not send messages, verify credentials or submit claims for you.

Explore the free previews before choosing your kit:
microtoolsstudio.com

Which task takes up more of your week: payment follow-ups, client onboarding or keeping records organized?

#MicroToolsStudio #FreelanceBusiness #SmallBusinessTools

Before chasing an invoice, check what is actually left to pay.

Fictional example: $120 invoiced, $50 confirmed received → $70 remaining. Record another $50 received and the balance becomes $20.

InvoiceForge helps keep that balance visible and prepare a follow-up draft you can review. You check your payment records and send the message yourself.

The $19 USD one-time Complete Kit includes a browser workspace, spreadsheet, fillable PDF and editable client messages. Applicable tax may be added. Files work separately; keep backups. Desktop or laptop recommended.

Try the free InvoiceForge preview at microtoolsstudio.com before buying.

Save this check for your next follow-up: invoice total, confirmed receipts, remaining balance.
